title: Hubble: verify the verifier
focus: Independence concerns the assumptions and physical references behind a test, not just the number of test results.

sources.title: The Hubble Space Telescope Optical Systems Failure Report, NASA-TM-103443
sources.limitations: Relevant sections inspected; this is not a reconstruction of every event or finding.

facts.statement: The board traced the primary-mirror figure error to an incorrectly assembled reflective null corrector used in manufacture and verification.
Other optical tests indicated an error, but their indications were discounted; the main corrector had not received an independent dimensional verification after assembly.

retrospective.boundary: Mirror, metrology fixture, fixture assembly, test interpretation, supplier oversight, and acceptance authority belong inside the optical acceptance boundary.
interfaces: Fixture geometry → optical result: an incorrect reference can make repeatable measurements misleading.
Anomalous test → acceptance decision: contradictory evidence needs a recorded resolution.

decision.question: Should agreement with the production reference close an optical acceptance claim?
options: Accept repeated agreement with the same reference.
Require an independent check of the reference and disposition conflicting measurements.
decision.recommendation: Choose evidence with a different failure mechanism and preserve unexplained disagreement.
decision.uncertainty: Independent measurement has its own uncertainty; two results are not a vote unless their error sources are understood.

rows: Record reference geometry and calibration chain
Use a different reference or physical principle
Keep acceptance claim open until resolved

questions: Which dependencies make apparently separate tests correlated?
How would you distinguish a bad test from a bad article?
Write an acceptance statement that admits unresolved conflicting evidence.
answer_signals: Maps shared fixtures, calibration, software, and assumptions.
Proposes a discriminating check before discarding an inconvenient result.
Keeps measurement repeatability separate from accuracy.
retrospective.transfer_exercise: Synthetic: two inspection systems use the same generated geometry file. Draft a third check that can detect an error in that file.
retrospective.limits: This case concerns the 1990 investigation. It does not claim that the proposed artifact was used by the project or that a new optical analysis was executed.
